parameters.help_en: The instance ID. This parameter is not required for public instances, but is required for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the edge instance.
The name can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It can be up to 20 characters in length, and each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例名称。
支持中文汉字、英文大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不超过20个字符（一个中文汉字算2个字符）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the edge instance. Each tag is in the `key:value` format. Separate multiple tags with commas (,). Example: `k1:v1,k2:v2`.
Limits instance tag keys:    
    - The key cannot be empty.
    - The key must be unique within the edge instance.
    - The key can contain only uppercase and lowercase letters.
    - The key can be up to 20 characters in length.
Limits instance tag values:
    - The value cannot be empty.
    - The value can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
    - The value can be up to 20 characters in length, and each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例标签。每个标签由`key:value`组成，多个标签间以英文逗号隔开。如`k1:v1,k2:v2`。
标签key限制如下：    
    - 不可为空。
    - 在该边缘实例中唯一。
    - 仅支持英文大小写。
    - 不可超过20个字符。
标签value限制如下：
    - 不可为空。
    - 支持中文、英文大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
    - 不可超过20个字符（一个中文汉字算2个字符）
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The product edition. Valid values:
10: Lite Edition.
20: Standard Edition.
30: Pro Edition.

Default value: 20 (Standard Edition)
parameters.help_zh:
产品规格。
10：轻量版。
20：标准版。
30：专业版。

默认值为20（标准版）
parameters.name: spec

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call is successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
